Name: Necromancy
Effect: The User cuts its HP in half (Rounded Down), Restore consciousness and half HP (Rounded Down) to a fainted Target. This Move fails if the User is not at full HP. If successful Spend 2 Will Points to activate. If no Target is fainted this Move fails. The Target does not need to be an Active Combatant.
Description: The User sacrifices its life-force to revive an Ally.
